source: The show's order as the owner passed it to Claude on 2026-09-27, recorded in scripts/place/rigs/moxir-2026-10-17.json (feat/moxir-hall) provenance.fixtureList: "18x UP-B380F, 12x UP-250BSW, 8x UP-HK1915, 50x UP-PL5403, 2x UP-LA40WF, CO2 x6, cold spark x4, smoke x4".
howToRead: One line per item on order. `code` is the rental house's own code as its spreadsheet prints it; `said` is the order's own words for the line. CO2, cold spark and smoke were ordered by kind: the rental house's spreadsheet lists exactly one item of each (UP-Q108S, UP-YH600F, UP-YZ31P), so those codes are its. Nothing here is confirmed by the rental house: the quote sheet in the spreadsheet is blank.
